items.title: Help the British Dietetic Association define safe staffing for paediatric home enteral feeding – the ASCEND project
items.summary: More babies, children and young people with complex conditions are now surviving, thanks to improvements in care from birth and the neonatal period onwards. The NHS 10 Year Health Plan also aims to move more care from hospital into the community.

items.title: BAPEN launches expression of our organisational purpose: Better Nutrition. Better Health. Better Lives.
items.summary: BAPEN is pleased to introduce a new expression of our purpose: Better Nutrition. Better Health. Better Lives.

items.title: MHRA publishes updated guidance on filter use during Parenteral Nutrition administration
items.summary: BAPEN would like to highlight two new publications from the Medicines and healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) concerning the administration of parenteral nutrition (PN) in all care settings.

items.title: Four weeks to go: Have you registered for the BAPEN Annual Conference 2026?
items.summary: With just four weeks until the BAPEN Annual Conference 2026, now is the ideal time to secure your place and make any necessary arrangements for study leave and attendance.

items.title: Last chance to submit Adult Intestinal Failure Registry Q2 2026 data
items.summary: The reporting period for collection of Adult Intestinal Failure Registry data for Q2 2026, covering 1st July to 30th September 2026, will close at midnight on Friday 16th October 2026.

items.title: BAPEN Position Statement on The Role Nutritional Support in the Management of Disease-Related malnutrition
items.summary: This position statement explores the role of nutritional support in the management of disease-related malnutrition, highlighting the importance of early identification and appropriate, evidence-based intervention.
